formulation: Susmel and Lazzarin (2002) modified Woehler curve, smooth-specimen high-cycle fatigue-limit branch

provenance.published_input: Susmel and Lazzarin (2002), Table 1: carbon steel 0.35% C, smooth specimen
provenance.expected_values: Independent analytical derivations in N04-susmel.tex, section D; not publication-reported numerical results or external implementation output

conventions.history: sigma(theta) = sigma_m + sigma_s sin(theta) + sigma_c cos(theta)
conventions.off_diagonal: physical Cauchy shear stress, not engineering shear strain
conventions.critical_plane: global maximiser of MCC shear amplitude; n and -n denote one plane
conventions.tau_a: minimum-circumscribed-circle radius of complete shear-vector path

verification_modes.prescribed_plane: Evaluate the exact harmonic formula on each numerical representative normal in critical_planes; compare stress-valued intermediates and D with absolute and relative float64 tolerances.
verification_modes.global_plane_search: Optimise tau_a over unoriented unit normals. Compare the maximum tau_a target only after convergence; evaluate D on a maximising plane subject to the case's final_result_policy. A finite grid alone has no fixed 1e-8 MPa accuracy guarantee.

tolerance.scope: Exact prescribed-plane and closed-form float64 harmonic evaluation only; near zero use absolute tolerance.
tolerance.global_search: Demonstrate orientation-search convergence separately; no universal angular-grid tolerance is specified.

material.note: Table 1 supplies fatigue-limit strengths, not matched curve slopes or a numerical native-life benchmark.

benchmarks.derivation: On a maximum-shear axial plane, tau_a=sigma_A/2 and sigma_n,max=sigma_A/2; D=tau_A.
benchmarks.source: P1 Table 1 material input; P1 Eqs. (5), (10)-(11); independent plane calculation

critical_planes.definition: n=e_x or n=e_y, up to sign

benchmarks.derivation: Both listed planes have maximum shear amplitude tau_A and zero normal traction.
benchmarks.source: P1 Table 1 material input; P1 Eqs. (5), (10)-(11); independent plane calculation

benchmarks.derivation: tau_a=sqrt((200/2)^2+80^2)=sqrt(16400); sigma_n,max=100 on both orthogonal maximum-shear planes; D=tau_a+19.3*(100/tau_a).
benchmarks.source: P1 Table 1 material input and Eqs. (5), (10)-(11); independent harmonic plane derivation

benchmarks.description: Combined axial-torsional loading with 90-degree phase shift

critical_planes.definition: All unit normals with |n_x|=1/sqrt(2) maximise MCC shear amplitude; the two listed xy normals give the previously reported prescribed-plane result
critical_planes.uniqueness: continuum of global maximisers with non-unique D

global_plane_search.final_result_policy: non-unique D; keep the original xy prescribed-plane result and the additional xz tied-plane result distinct

benchmarks.source: P1 Table 1 material input and Eqs. (1), (5), (10)-(11); independent quadrature calculation

benchmarks.description: Fully reversed axial component with tensile mean normal stress
benchmarks.derivation: Mean normal stress=100/2; alternating normal and shear amplitudes=200/2; D=100+19.3*1.5.
benchmarks.source: P1 Table 1 material input and Eqs. (1), (5), (10)-(11); independent mean-stress calculation

benchmarks.description: Two-dimensional shear ellipse distinguishing MCC from RSS/MCE

critical_planes.uniqueness: other maximisers need not be excluded for this exact-plane check

benchmarks.derivation: The Gram matrix is diag(100^2,60^2); MCC radius=100, whereas RSS/MCE=sqrt(100^2+60^2).
benchmarks.source: P1 geometric MCC definition and Table 1 material input; independent harmonic-ellipse calculation

benchmarks.description: Tied maximum-shear planes with non-unique final assessment

critical_planes.definition: n=e_x and n=e_y are tied global maximum-shear planes
critical_planes.uniqueness: not unique under the original paper; no tie rule supplied

global_plane_search.final_result_policy: non-unique D; retain both tied-plane candidate outcomes

benchmarks.derivation: Global maximum shear=max(160/2,100)=100; the two tied planes have different normal maxima, so the final index is set-valued without a tie policy.
benchmarks.source: P1 maximum-shear plane definition and Table 1 material input; independent tied-plane construction
benchmarks.test_requirement: Verify both candidate-plane values to absolute 1e-8 MPa; do not assert one original-method output.

benchmarks.description: Zero-shear hydrostatic harmonic, including zero-load limit

critical_planes.definition: any plane; all have zero shear

global_plane_search.final_result_policy: undefined rho, D and U for both numerical instances

benchmarks.derivation: For sigma(theta)=p I sin(theta), every plane has zero shear traction; rho divides by tau_a=0. At p=0, rho=0/0 is also undefined.
benchmarks.source: P1 Eq. (5) ratio and Eq. (10)-(11); independent zero-shear limit. The p=100 MPa numerical instances are illustrative inputs, not published values.
benchmarks.test_requirement: Require an explicit unsupported/undefined-domain outcome, never a fabricated finite damage value.
